record.edic_text:
805 asphalizo {as-fal-id'-zo}

from 804; TDNT - 1:506,87; v

AV - make sure 3, make fast 1; 4

1) to make firm, to make secure (against harm)
2) to be made secure

same.cexp: 平安無事，安全；正確，完備
安全的，正確的；妥當的；具體的
安全地，嚴密看守地；確實，無疑地
